data.title: Anna Brockman, Wife to One of the “Kings of AI,” Is a Republican Mega-Donor. What Is It Like to Be Queen?
data.description: Before she married OpenAI’s Greg Brockman, she was Anna Chang, an idealistic, animal-loving Wesleyan graduate. Now the couple, worth nearly $30 billion, are two of the biggest mega-donors this midterms cycle.
data.author: Julia Black
